title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
original_title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by Georges Perec’s A Man Asleep, the film examines contemporary alienation in a today’s emotionally numbed world of hyperconnectivity and endless information.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: In The Weeds
overview: An obsessive husband discovers an unkillable weed that begins to threaten his suburban and so-called "perfect life."

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: Cegsex
overview: When a mouth erupts on Tomos's arm after trying to bypass online porn restrictions, he must muffle his sins before mum finds out.

title: Aurora Ave: Sunrise to Sunset
overview: This documentary captures Seattle’s infamous Aurora Avenue from morning to night.

title: Dependence
overview: Even as a child, Grace Harper Brighouse was always filming her family. Now faced with her father’s death, Grace returns to this personal archive to piece together an unflinching account of his struggle with addiction to opioids and the impact it had on them. Dependence is a bold excavation of the things we hide to protect the ones we love.

title: Magick Mtn.
overview: Lord Mmorke, a tepid and ghoulish narrator, walks us through 3 separate fables all intersecting in a realm beyond the tangible. Rituals and retellings about a Deathrock squatter jailed by a sadistic psychiatrist and the evils of regret, a pair of criminal plumbers plunging further towards Hell's grips and the beer-soaked leather of the Sunset Strip, and an architect's ambition built on the shaky bedrock of the Devil's promise. What begins as a tale ends in a spell cast upon unsuspecting characters and audiences alike

title: Kill Me Now
overview: A writer on a deadline to finish her first Hollywood thriller seeks solace in her home. Life imitates art as she becomes convinced her neighbor is going to kill her.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: Peculiar Green
overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

title: Kung Fu Deadly
overview: Danny and Frank, two bumbling pest exterminators, cross paths with the enigmatic Lien, a Taoist guardian hunting an ancient Chinese jiangshi in Dublin. Together they set out to deal with this menace the only way they know how: extermination.

title: Best of the Best
overview: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

title: Windows of Time
overview: A divine vision inspired Hubert Taylor to pick up a home video camera and spend decades documenting the life of his Georgia hometown. His gaze keeps returning to his own father, the gospel singer Brother Theotis Taylor, whose legendary falsetto took him to Carnegie Hall. With co-director and music archivist Cyrus Moussavi, he unearths an unseen community archive and shapes it into a moving meditation on art, family, community, and legacy.

title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

title: Optimus Prime Awakening
overview: An animated epilogue to The Transformers: The Movie (1986) and the final performance of Peter Cullen.

title: That Photo In My Wallet
overview: A lonely teenage girl struggles to navigates an overwhelming sense of isolation that alienates the people closest to her.

title: Jollyface
overview: The  movie follows a woman investigating a murder while being hunted in her apartment building.

title: Death of a Yellow Bird
overview: A terminally ill man returns to his childhood home searching for closure. While there he discovers, buried in the earth, the family’s long lost VHS camera. Inside the camera he finds a video tape of home movies. But as he watches, something disturbing begins bleeding through the static.

title: WORKING HARD OR HARDLY WORKING?
overview: A girl avoids doing her homework.

title: Pixel generation(s)
overview: The original video is filmed again and again.

title: Cycle centrifuge
overview: An essay film on deprivation, in which physical isolation becomes a space for inner escape.

title: Big Daddy’s Flowers
overview: A flower delivery driver becomes involved in the business of a mysterious crime boss.

title: We Set the House on Fire
original_title: We Set the House on Fire
overview: Five strangers happen upon a mysterious house on New Years Eve, their secrets and connections begin to be uncovered as the night takes a supernatural turn.

title: Stella by Starlight
overview: On Stella’s 29th birthday, four days before her band is set to embark on a career-altering tour, she learns that it is canceled. As she scrambles to salvage the tour and rally her bandmates, tensions rise, threatening not just the tour but the band's future.

title: PRIDEFALL
overview: Ben Goode, an arcade employee, gets a chance to win $20,000 in an air hockey tournament. But it won't be as easy as he thinks when Max Puck, an egotistical air hockey try-hard, signs up.

title: England 'Til I Die
overview: Filmed as events unfold, an anonymous protester is transformed into a prominent figure in Britain's growing anti-immigration movement.

title: Gluten
overview: A "couple" on a failed date encounter a zombie. Things can't be good after this.

title: After Impact
overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Building
overview: Set during the construction of the World Trade Center in 1970s New York. After a co-worker starts spreading false rumors about him and the boss' daughter, an electrician retaliates with an escalating series of anonymous prank notes. The notes spread as gossip through the crew, sparking a psychological war of rumors and retaliation amid the daily grind of construction work.

title: Countryside
overview: Estranged brothers, Sean and Luke, return to their rural childhood home. When a zombie outbreak throws the world into chaos, they have no choice but to confront the sacrifices they are willing to make for family.

title: Still Night, Burning House
overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

title: Gail
overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.

title: Falling into Place
overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Between Late April and Early May
original_title: Between Late April and Early May
overview: A docu-fiction film that captures the oddities and absurdities of human behaviour during the annual cherry blossom bloom in High Park, Toronto.

title: Order of Insects
overview: A pregnant housewife grapples with her identity as a wife and mother as she plunges deeper into her obsession with bugs.

title: Mindflip
overview: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Rapinoe
overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

title: Foster
overview: Haunted by his past and clawing his way through sobriety, Donald 'Don' Foster just wants some peace. When a troubled addict leaves her young son on his doorstep, Foster is dragged back into the violent underworld he thought he left behind. Hunted by his ruthless mafia boss ex-employer – of whom he knows all his sinister secrets – Foster has a reason to seek redemption.

title: The Uprising
overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

title: When America Took the Field
overview: How baseball helped restore normalcy and unite the country after the September 11 attacks.

title: Swarm
overview: Swarm, 2026, McCall’s most recent work, premiering in the exhibition, draws on the rising significance of drones as an increasing presence in daily life. The installation is composed of two conical-light volumes that rotate slowly in opposite directions, one clockwise and the other counterclockwise, over a duration of fifteen minutes. Accompanying the mesmerizing visuals is a rich soundscape that gradually intensifies as a powerful auditory experience. The dramatic, progressive soundtrack serves as a continuation of the ongoing collaboration between McCall and Grubbs.

title: Charlie: The Last Debate
overview: The Last Debate. But the first movie in the slop cinematic universe. Go on a riveting journey that explores the personal lives of Charlie and his assassin Tyler, and drown in the moral ambiguity of the murder of a human being.

title: Something´s Wrong With This Cabinet
overview: A man wakes to what appears to be an ordinary morning. As he follows his familiar routine, subtle details begin to feel strangely out of place, leading to an unsettling realization that something is not quite right.

title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Space Busted
original_title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Space Busted
overview: Supergirl takes Krypto the Superdog on an adventure into space! Can he save the aliens he meets along the way?

title: Please, I Am Starving
overview: A hungry killer wanders into someone's house at night.

title: Glowurm
overview: A group of young eco-hackers infiltrates an abandoned experimental center in the Alps to document a space-time anomaly - a hidden dimension that transforms into a trap.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: Last One Alive Wins $11,000,000
overview: Mack Hopkins gathered 100 players to compete for $11,000,000. The winner gets to live.

title: Hallucinating In The Dark
overview: In the depths of icy cold blue light, God emerged in smirking glory with a gentle touch and the promise of a brighter tomorrow. What God failed to take into account, however, was the possibility that we may be deaf to his words.

title: Maison Margiela | ANONYMITY
overview: As she prepares for a role, an actress repeatedly comes face-to-face with her masked double, forcing her to confront her own identity.  But who is real? How can we truly know ourselves? The stakes have never been higher. That is "ANONYMITY".

title: Well Being
overview: Short film written by Emir Kuliev, directed by Kevin McNally.

title: Saving Black Bear
overview: When the departure of a longtime manager threatens to shutter an already struggling movie theater in small-town Maine, a band of misfit employees fights to save the place that brought them together.

title: Biff the Human Slayer
overview: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.

title: Love Reins at Christmas
overview: A widowed mother, Grace Guidry, is struggling to keep her family farm running. Throughout the holiday season, she must navigate the immense challenges of farm life and the complexities of finding hope and love again.

title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
original_title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
overview: After his domineering mother dies, reclusive farmer Ed Gein descends into madness, hearing her voice urging him to punish sinful women and turning his home into a house of horrors.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: NECROPOLIS
overview: A Stone Tape film inspired by the yellow fever epidemic in 19th century New Orleans, using analog camera techniques and contact microphones to excavate the material traces of trauma. Coined by archaeologist and parapsychologist T.C. Lethbridge, Stone Tape Theory posits that material objects record traumatic events of the past… and that they can be played back.

title: IMAGO
overview: The third part of the Camera Insectorum series, filmed using a pinhole/lensless camera, is a brief, almost poetic meditation on the light that inscribes its path into the dark of the camera. The image strives to hold still a living entity that never coincides with its own imprint, leaving a space-resistance and eternal elusiveness.

title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
original_title: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Prelude to a Wedding
overview: When Gethsemane is invited to play at a wedding, she and Eamon find themselves involved in the death of a member of the bridal party.

title: Mr. Vapey Man
overview: He's packed with juicy flavors. You'll never get enough if you let him give you - just. One. Puff. It's a new era, and no one is afraid of the boogeyman anymore. Unfortunately, something far worse is hiding under the bed.

title: Rain Rain Go Away
overview: Heartbroken after losing an interracial relationship, a young man meets a woman at a Kuala Lumpur bus stop during a rainpour. As they share their stories of love and loss, her uncanny resemblance to his former lover forces him to confront memory, grief, and letting go.

title: We Remember What We Remember
overview: After over a decade since graduating secondary school, the filmmaker gathers old friends to ‘remember’ the collective memory of their school life, ‘revealing’ different perspectives of incidents and ‘resolve’ the lingering trauma of adolescence.

title: Worm Regards
overview: A group of four friends are hired by the mysterious Mr. E to retrieve and deliver to him the remains of the equally mysterious Maurice Thomas Graves, resulting in many strange interactions at his café.

title: Ourselves in the Archives
overview: Ourselves in the Archives is a historical tale featuring a forbidden love story. Eleanore's family is set on her being wed, despite her objections she feels like she has no say. Eleanore runs off to meet Tilly, a maid who she'd much rather spend her days with. But how will history remember her?

title: Marginalia
overview: Built from empty shots from vintage gay porn and a text written to an ex-partner, the film moves from an apartment in New York to Europe, the beach, and the mountains before returning home to the city, like the long vacation one might need after a breakup.

title: Sesudah Taiping
overview: Champ, Jay, and Adam visit their old friend, Khidir in Taiping after his mother passes away. Champ noticea an unsettling change: Khidir is entirely consumed by A.I. even to communicate. The trio sets out to find answers.

title: Hong Kong, Let's Get Married
overview: This documentary follows Hong Kong’s same-sex marriage movement through court challenges, activism, and personal stories as couples and advocates pursue recognition and equality.

title: Zrywka
overview: A harsh, unforgiving environment—forests covering mountain slopes and the crash of falling trees punctuated by the heavy breathing of horses. In these conditions, the bond between human and animal is put to the test. Where does the line lie between exploitation and humane treatment? How do we define our place in the natural world? This film certainly offers no clear answers.

title: One Man's Mission
overview: For over 30 years, Hoshiar Ali has been clearing landmines in the Halabja region of Iraqi Kurdistan. Despite losing both his legs and his loved ones, he has dedicated his life to saving others. This is the documentary story of a man whose personal tragedy transformed into a mission of service to humanity.

title: Ptaki Wędrowne
overview: Ryszard, a retired foreign language teacher, sets out on the final journey of his life. He chooses Kazakhstan as his destination—the place where, for ten years, he taught the native language to the descendants of Polish exiles. Upon arriving in the village of Pervomayka, located in the heart of the steppe, he learns that a delegation from the Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs is due to visit soon. There is no teacher in the village, so Ryszard steps in to prepare a welcoming artistic program with the students for the visiting officials.

title: American Summer
overview: Now in his 60s, Mikey vividly journeys back to his childhood during one of the best summers of his life when he met the girl of his dreams, Kelly, scored a spot on the travel baseball team, worked his first job and began his growth out of boyhood — all in the sudden wake of his father missing overseas on a military mission.

title: Disney Pixar Cars: Race to Celebrate
original_title: Disney Pixar Cars: Race to Celebrate
overview: 'There’s a new holiday in Radiator Springs – Lightning McQueen Day! But shhhh … it’s a surprise!  Celebrate 20 years of Disney and Pixar’s Cars with a surprise party in Radiator Springs!  Return to Radiator Springs for an all-new adventure just in time for the 20th anniversary of the original Cars film! This story is sure to delight fans of all ages as Mater, Sally, Cruz, and their friends throw a surprise party to celebrate their favorite racer on the first annual Lightning McQueen Day.'

title: Rent in Peace
overview: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

title: Final Transmissions
overview: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Hell's Scooters
overview: A young man once known as "Jukebox" recounts to his wife his days as a member of the infamous Lime Scooter gang, and how the fun life he once knew quickly spiraled into something much darker than he could have ever imagined...

title: Mim i jego wnuczka
overview: At the age of twenty, Bogdan left Poland following the tragic events surrounding his father's murder by the militia. He ended up in France, where fate led him to the Parisian mime school of the legendary Marcel Marceau. Marceau recognized his talent and appointed him as his assistant. After a successful career abroad, Bogdan returned to his hometown of Bolesławiec for a well-earned retirement. There, he eventually discovered a flair for the stage in his six-year-old granddaughter, Blanka. He decided to pass on his knowledge and experience by teaching her the art of mime.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: The Blue Sea
overview: A fisherman has the impression that he is rotting from the inside, like one of his teeth that is bothering him. Lost in the maze of his painful memories, frustrated by the sense of disorder that surrounds him, he is helpless in the face of the spectacle of the repressed demonstrators he sees every day on television. His depression causes his body to melt in an abstract way and to disperse in trails of droplets, in the manner of Francis Bacon's portraits.

title: How Does it Feel to be This Close to Home?
original_title: How Does it Feel to be This Close to Home?
overview: Sam sets off to complete her estranged father's final wish of spreading his ashes. However, when Sam’s car breaks down at the side of the road, will she continue her journey to discover more about her father, or will her resentment of him overpower her, ultimately leaving his memory on the side of a busy road?

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Eternity One
overview: ETERNITY ONE follows Mary Ella, a young girl growing up on Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay, where rising seas have already claimed two-thirds of the land and threaten to erase what remains. Once a thriving fishing community, Tangier now faces the collapse of both home and livelihood.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story

title: Homeys

title: Death Do Us Part

title: Until You're Alone

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

Beyond the gridiron, they confront a myriad of trials, from the complexities of post-football existence to the allure of delving into the underworld of organized crime. As they traverse this tumultuous landscape, they glean invaluable insights and grapple with profound life lessons, shaping their destinies in unexpected ways.

title: At Night

A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: Lads Being Lads: Screen Time
overview: In this episode, the lads are challenged by James to ditch their phones and begin to connect with life like they never have before. All which leads to the group splitting and ending up facing the unfair reality of their separate paths. All in the hopes of trying something new.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: end of beginning
overview: After waking up with no memory of his past, a man pieces together his life through archival photos and footage of the places he’s been, uncovering fragments of the identities he once lived as he confronts the relentless passage of time.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: Pasear a un perro
overview: On another monotonous night in Javier's life, he goes out to walk his dog while thinking about the movie he just saw, not knowing that a small event is going to take him out of his depressing routine.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
overview: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: How To Be Happy
overview: When Max goes through a messy breakup he has to figure out how to get over his sad patch.

title: Blood Mandate
overview: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Anchors Aweigh

title: Under the Mound
overview: In present-day Texas, a story and music video inspired by the classic novel "Carmilla," is Laura, who's fallen in love with a peculiar girl whose behavior has grown increasingly more erratic and suspicious. Using her intuition and dreams she must come to terms with the fact that their faith in each other is about to be tested.

title: Donnie & Dude: Do Dudley
overview: When two stoners go on a journey from Sedgley to a charity shop in Dudley, they run into trouble with a sergeant, two rival stoners (Stupid caveman Chris and chill annoying Sam) and his special “Anti-Weed Task Force” (A.W.T.F) When they finally get a copy of a dvd from the charity shop, a mysterious evil character called “Gimp Man” comes to take it from them. With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: The Country They Call Life
overview: A spirit must choose between life and death with only the help of a suicidal man.

title: Jack-O 2: Blood Moon Rising
overview: sequel to the VHS rental classic Jack-O

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
original_title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
overview: Concorde was an icon of the skies, but on 25 July 2000, Air France Flight 4590 left Paris for New York and caught fire during take-off before crashing to the ground just over a minute later, killing everyone on board. The tragedy brought an end to the dream of supersonic passenger flight. But what caused the disaster? Investigators, survivors’ loved ones and those who examined the wreckage recall the tragedy and describe how the evidence led to a shockingly simple conclusion about what went wrong.

title: Splash City
overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

title: Daisy

title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
overview: Marcus, a customer service agent whose job is to help anyone with anything with the aid of Assist-O, a hyper-efficient AI assistant. When the tasks become increasingly bizarre and Assist-O starts taking things too far, Marcus struggles to maintain control, revealing the chaos and absurdity lurking behind the promise of perfect service.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Darkroom

title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
overview: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

title: Yurt
overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the shooting of a portion of The Short Life of Jaxon Blume on an apple farm in Kent, United Kingdom.

title: A Thing of the Past

title: Cornellskop: Freedom From Fear

title: The Alice Paradox

title: Separate Ways
overview: The story follows Leah, a resilient young woman navigating a world reshaped by a sudden and terrifying outbreak. As society collapses and the threat of the undead looms, Leah struggles not only to survive the new dangers around her but also to process the emotional weight of her past. Through haunting flashbacks, we glimpse her relationship with Mason-her longtime partner-and the unresolved tensions, love, and missed moments that defined their life before everything changed. Blending intimate relationship drama with apocalyptic horror, the film explores how ordinary human conflicts are magnified in extraordinary circumstances. As Leah moves between memories of what once was and the harsh reality of what now is, she's forced to confront loss, love, and the difficult choices that come with survival.

title: The Catalyst
overview: A university student seizes control of time when he is endowed with a divine golden necklace -- 'the Catalyst' -- which grants him the ability to restart the day, only to learn that limitless productivity comes at a dangerous cost.

title: How Was Your Day?
overview: Ben’s days are a mess of minor catastrophes that only seem to get worse. But none of it matters, because he lives with roommates who never let him get a word in. As the interruptions pile up, the question becomes less dramatic and more ridiculous: will Ben ever get to talk about his day?

title: INT. HALLWAY / NIGHT
overview: Int. Hallway / Night follows a comedy director replacing a director on an existential B-horror film, starring his adulterous wife and her lover. He soon realizes the plot eerily mirrors his darkest fantasies of revenge.

title: The Stanmore Incident
overview: Three friends stumble upon a mysterious light in the sky, triggering a terrifying pursuit by unseen forces ...

title: I am a River

The veil-like formations it creates evoke the fluid, fragile, ever-changing essence of rivers, suggesting they are living entities, much like us.

As storms rise and legends awaken, Kael must forge uneasy alliances and face the truth that balance demands responsibility, not peace. What seems like an invasion is revealed to be a warning… and a sign that something far greater is already in motion.

title: A-Men to That
overview: A musical odyssey in male friendships seen through three x male models with a desperate grip on their youth entering the world of pop and trying to become a man-band.

title: A Blank Frame

title: Everest: Journey to the Top of the World with Mike Tobin

overview: Hundreds have died attempting to climb Mount Everest. The behemoth, named "goddess mother of the earth" by the Tibetans and "goddess of the sky" by the Nepalese, has long attracted explorers seeking challenge or glory. "Everest: Journey to the Top of the World" follows Tobin's preparation for and journey to the summit as he interviews fellow adventurers he meets along the way.

title: Liminals

Through film, sound, and light, boundaries dissolve between inner and outer worlds, living and non-living matter. Inspired by quantum theory, Huyghe collaborated with physicist Tommaso Calarco and philosopher Tobias Rees. The film translates quantum uncertainty into sensory experiences, with sound design even shaped by a 100-qubit quantum computer. Ultimately, Huyghe invites us to confront a “radical outside” of human subjectivity, where multiple realities coexist.

title: La Tierra del Valor (The Home of the Brave)
original_title: La Tierra del Valor (The Home of the Brave)
overview: During a summer of grief and fear brought on by immigration raids in Los Angeles, one small act of bravery gives a community hope.

title: T1D
overview: T1D is an expository documentary about living with type one diabetes. The main Subjects are Sarah and Maria. They will tell their unique story of how they got diagnosed, how they lived with it after and how it is living with it now. Type one diabetes is a chronic autoimmune illness in which the body's immune system mistakenly attacks the insulin producing cells in the pancreas, which causes high blood sugar levels. This documentary will lead to education about T1D and people living with it.

title: Mudlarking

Once Willie secures his cast, crew, and a partnership with a disturbingly sketchy financier, his production is thrown into total chaos and mayhem.  Can he complete his movie before his whole world crashes down?

overview: Stop motion sequence created by Dillon Duffy.

title: Birds Eye View

Filmed in 10 hours over a period of 5 weeks the project was designed to provide the actors with experience of shooting on location and applying skill learnt in the studio prior to heading out on to location. For some of the cast this is their very first experience of acting for screen.

original_title: The Wicked Witch of Marty Mauser

title: A Corpse Awaiting Resurrection
overview: An empty body without purpose waits to be saved by a great, unknown force.

title: Goons Galore - Revenge of the Goons
original_title: Goons Galore - Revenge of the Goons
overview: Peace-loving drug lord Cosmo B. Fruitfly faces peril as his elite spy is kidnapped by his violent opposer, Ricardo Trentino and his nasty henchmen. With the fate of peace at stake, Fruitfly sends his two most loyal goons to rescue our captured co-vert agent.

title: Quod Corpus Tenet
overview: Quod Corpus Tenet follows Louise, a 17-year-old student spending an ordinary afternoon studying alone in a library cubicle. Surrounded by silence and routine, her focus is subtly disrupted by a news broadcast playing nearby. What first feels like background noise begins to resonate more deeply, awakening emotions she has long kept buried.  As the outside world intrudes, the confined space becomes increasingly oppressive. Through tight framing, shifting colour tones, and an immersive soundscape, the film traces Louise’s inner unraveling as suppressed trauma surfaces. Reality and memory blur, and the act of studying turns into a struggle for control.  A restrained psychological drama, Quod Corpus Tenet explores the weight the body carries when silence becomes unbearable, inviting the audience into an intimate and unsettling experience of repression, vulnerability, and emotional collapse.

title: Listen to Yourself

title: Portrait of a Young Man
overview: Gray, an obsessive angsty teenager, must make peace with his struggling family in order to overcome emotional bonds and personal afflictions.

title: Entertaining an Evening Projectionist
overview: How do you entertain yourself while entertaining others? A short documentary about a nighttime projectionist passing the time.

title: Porky Pig vs The Pigman
overview: Porky Pig and Piglet vacation into a Vermont cabin when The Vermont Pigman awakes from his century long sleep. Porky and Piglet have to escape or find themselves slashed by the cryptid. This film is in no way affiliated with Warner Brothers, Disney, or any companies associated with the characters used. This is a parody made with satirical intent.
